title: Racing the Clock: Teaching VLNs Budget-Conditioned Object Search
abstract: arXiv:2611.17442v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A rescue robot entering a building with thirty seconds on the clock should sprint toward the single most promising room; given ten minutes, it should instead explore a broader tour. Yet vision-language-navigation (VLN) models are typically evaluated under a fixed episode limit that the policy never observes, even though time-critical missions require behavior to adapt to the available budget. We study budget-conditioned object search: given a target category and an explicit action budget, an agent must find as many distinct target instances as possible before the budget expires. We investigate how to supervise VLNs for this task by comparing a privileged TSP expert, which plans near-optimal routes using the full map and true target locations, with a room-level Bellman expert that maximizes expected return under partial observability using high-level cross-scene semantic priors. translated_title: 争分夺秒：教会视觉语言导航模型进行预算条件下的目标搜索
translated_abstract: 当救援机器人只有三十秒的时间进入一栋建筑时，它应该冲向最有希望的那一个房间；而如果有十分钟，它则应该进行更广泛的探索。然而，视觉语言导航（VLN）模型通常在固定的回合限制下进行评估，而策略本身从未观测到这一限制，尽管时间紧迫的任务要求行为能够根据可用时间预算进行调整。我们研究预算条件下的目标搜索任务：给定一个目标类别和一个明确的动作预算，智能体必须在预算耗尽之前找到尽可能多的不同目标实例。我们通过对比两种专家来研究如何为此任务监督VLN模型：一种是特权TSP专家，它利用完整地图和真实目标位置规划接近最优的路线；另一种是房间级Bellman专家，它在部分可观测条件下，利用高层跨场景语义先验来最大化期望回报。尽管TSP专家取得了显著更高的期望……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出“预算条件下的目标搜索”新任务，使视觉语言导航智能体能够根据明确的动作预算自适应调整搜索策略，并对比了基于特权信息的TSP专家与基于部分可观测和跨场景语义先验的房间级Bellman专家两种监督方案。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces budget-conditioned object search, a new VLN task where agents must adapt their search behavior to an explicit action budget, and compares a privileged TSP expert against a room-level Bellman expert that leverages cross-scene semantic priors under partial observability.
